thinking:
"学途" (XueTu), an online learning platform.
Language, computer skills, and exam preparation courses.
University students and young professionals.
Home page, Course List (with categories/prices), Course Detail (schedule/teacher), Registration page.
Professional, ready-to-deploy, static website.
Simplified Chinese.

        *   Relative paths for links.
        *   No `target="_blank"`.
        *   No external CSS/JS/fonts.
        *   No AI/placeholder text (Lorem Ipsum).
        *   Responsive design (optimized for 1440px).
        *   No AI mentions in meta tags, comments, etc.
        *   Format: `===== FILE: filename =====`.

    *   *Colors:* Professional blue, white, and light grey. Accents of orange or green for CTAs (Call to Action).
    *   *Layout:*
        *   Header: Logo (Text "学途"), Navigation (Home, Courses, About/Contact).
        *   Footer: Copyright, Quick Links.
    *   *Page Structure:*
        *   `index.html`: Hero section, features, featured courses, testimonials.
        *   `courses.html`: Filter categories, course cards (title, price, description, "Learn More").
        *   `course-detail.html`: Course description, syllabus, instructor bio, schedule, "Enroll" button (linking to registration).
        *   `register.html`: Form for user details.

    *   *Languages:* English (IELTS/TOEFL), Japanese (JLPT), Spanish.
    *   *Computer Skills:* Python for Data Analysis, Full-stack Web Development, AWS Cloud Certification.
    *   *Exam Prep:* CFA Level 1, CPA, Civil Service Exam.

    *   *Index.html:* Needs a strong value proposition. "Unlock your potential" (开启你的潜能).
    *   *Courses.html:* Needs categories.
        *   Category 1: 语言学习 (Languages)
        *   Category 2: 计算机技能 (Computer Skills)
        *   Category 3: 证书考试 (Certifications)
    *   *Course-Detail.html:* Pick one course (e.g., Python for Data Analysis). Detail the 12-week plan.
    *   *Register.html:* Standard form (Name, Email, Phone, Course Selection).

    *   Ensure CSS is embedded.
    *   Check all links: `index.html`, `courses.html`, `course-detail.html`, `register.html`.
    *   Verify no external assets.
    *   Ensure no "AI" or "Lorem Ipsum".

    *   *CSS:* Use a modern flexbox/grid layout. Google-esque clean look.
    *   *JS:* Simple interactivity (e.g., form submission alert, category filter logic if possible, though static is fine).
